limitations: Single-speed calibration, not statistical or kinematic validation.
Touch threshold is an engineering load detector, not tactile receptor sensitivity.
Foot-site velocity includes pad rotation/rolling; it is not exact contact-point slip.
Joint-angle proxies are not yet validated against the Jagnandan landmark convention.
Biological SEM and raw/residualized multi-lab values are not universal tolerances.
Temperatures label the literature validity envelope; this model has no thermal dynamics.

deferred.frequency_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.stride_length_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.tail_amplitude_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.tail_height_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.COM_energy_recovery: Not computed from trunk proxy; requires whole-model COM and a matched speed protocol.
deferred.strike_shake: 50 Hz gait trace cannot resolve strike kinematics; log >=500 Hz before filtering.

gait.diagonality_definition: Circular temporal separation of diagonal touchdown pairs; 0=simultaneous. Not an independently validated scalar index.

contact_quality.note: No-cycle limbs are unmeasurable, not a valid zero-frequency gait. Sub-control-step contacts are not resolved.

limitations: One occurrence per detected bout; a continuous long walk is not recounted once per body length.
Movement/bout thresholds are numerical engineering choices; these are not manual animal ethogram annotations.
An orientation proxy needs joint movement, not just a sliding or passively drifting body.
Rest is inactivity, not evidence of sleep; nonzero head/tail/joint motion prevents rest classification.
Endpoint bouts are censored and flagged; their counted occurrence is observed but onset/offset may be outside recording.
No-prey fixed-heading gait tests and short episodes cannot validate published enclosure event proportions or rates.
Unrepresented categories are unavailable, never imputed as zero or used to renormalize published budgets.

claim: Instrumented simulation diagnostics; no biological validation claimed.
repeat_note: Different seeds with reset_noise=0 repeat the same deterministic experiment, not independent animal samples.

hind_duty_factor.source: Jagnandan & Higham (2017), Sci Rep 7:10865, doi:10.1038/s41598-017-11484-7; McElroy, Hickey & Reilly (2008)
hind_duty_factor.notes: Chosen aggregate target; source-study values differ. Not a pooled statistical estimate.

hind_duty_factor_range.source: Jagnandan & Higham (2017), Sci Rep 7:10865, doi:10.1038/s41598-017-11484-7; McElroy, Hickey & Reilly (2008)

fore_duty_factor_tolerance.notes: Reported SEM from supplied table, not prediction interval.

limb_phase_range.source: McElroy, Hickey & Reilly (2008), J Exp Biol 211:1029
limb_phase_range.notes: Ipsilateral hind-to-fore phase, supplied-source walk/run summary.

stride_length_svl_range.source: Jagnandan & Higham (2017), Sci Rep 7:10865, doi:10.1038/s41598-017-11484-7; Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916; Fuller, Higham & Clark (2011), Zoology 114:104–112, Table 1, doi:10.1016/j.zool.2010.11.003
stride_length_svl_range.notes: Cross-study envelope. Fit stride length, not independently cadence and speed, since v=stride length*frequency.

walking_speed_m_s_range.notes: Supplied voluntary-study envelope, not sprint speed.

trunk_pitch_deg.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916
trunk_pitch_deg.notes: Supplied intact-tail walking value; sign convention must be explicit.

trunk_pitch_sem_deg.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916
trunk_pitch_sem_deg.notes: Supplied reported SEM, not an engineering tolerance.

hip_height_svl.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916
hip_height_svl.notes: Walking measurement used as a static neutral-control engineering gate. Settled stance is not the same experimental protocol.

shoulder_height_svl.source: Jagnandan, Russell & Higham (2014), J Exp Biol 217:3891–3897, doi:10.1242/jeb.110916; CODEX_PROMPT.md (user build brief, 2026-09-05)
shoulder_height_svl.notes: Build target; the supplied paper table rounds shoulder height to 0.11 SVL. Static neutral-control proxy for walking height.

literature_comparison_warning: Reference values retain source/species/provenance and are context, not acceptance gates. Multi-study or residualized values and animal SEMs cannot certify this raw single-speed trace; anatomical landmark conventions still require validation.

summary.note: Scorable partial episodes remain labelled; do not hide early falls by averaging only survivors.
